verdict.rationale: A runtime probe found a live llms.txt at phaser.io that serves as an examples-API index pointing agents at a programmatic examples endpoint. However, the main docs site has no llms.txt and no markdown page variants (both 404), and phaser.io blocks non-browser clients, which limits direct agent fetching. Missing for 10: llms.txt or agent-oriented coverage of the core documentation (docs.phaser.io llms.txt and .md pages 404), unauthenticated non-browser agent access, first-party documentation of the llms.txt, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: phaser.io/llms.txt is live as a programmatic examples-API index ('# Phaser Examples Index... For full metadata and source code, use the API: GET /api/v1/examples/{id}')
Caveat: phaser.io root 403s non-browser clients — deep links and a browser UA required.
